schema:
CREATE TABLE athletes (athlete_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT NOT NULL, last_name TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE time_trials (trial_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, athlete_id INTEGER NOT NULL, split_time TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (athlete_id) REFERENCES athletes(athlete_id));
correct_query: SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTRING(T2.split_time, 1, INSTR(T2.split_time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTRING(T2.split_time, INSTR(T2.split_time, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) FROM athletes AS T1 INNER JOIN time_trials AS T2 ON T1.athlete_id = T2.athlete_id WHERE T1.last_name = 'Clark' AND T1.first_name = 'Nina'
